```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)

# Color scheme for consistent visuals
theme_set(theme_minimal())
```

This comprehensive report analyzes the structure and dynamics of public expenditure across EU-27 countries from 2006 to 2021. The analysis examines both economic classification (P2, D1, P5) and functional composition (COFOG) of government spending, with particular focus on outsourcing patterns and expenditure dynamics.


```{r}
# Load the pre-generated results
setwd("/Users/sofiaperondi/Desktop/Tesina IV /Data selection and summary analysis /Downloaded data")
out_dir <- "outputs_eurostat_comprehensive"

# Load summary statistics
summary_stats <- fread(file.path(out_dir, "summary_statistics.csv"))
growth_year <- fread(file.path(out_dir, "growth_rates_p2_d1_p5.csv"))
composition_year <- fread(file.path(out_dir, "composition_economic_type.csv"))
cofog_long <- fread(file.path(out_dir, "composition_cofog.csv"))
substitution_trends <- fread(file.path(out_dir, "substitution_trends.csv"))
country_variation <- fread(file.path(out_dir, "country_variation_2021.csv"))
```

```{r}
cat("**Data Sources and Processing:**\n\n")
cat("• **Source**: Eurostat gov_10a_main dataset\n")
cat("• **Period**: 2006-2021 (16 years)\n")
cat("• **Coverage**: 27 EU member states\n")
cat("• **Values**: Real terms (2010 prices, millions of euros)\n")
cat("• **Cleaning**: Removed duplicates and extreme values\n")
cat("• **Growth Rates**: Proper year-over-year calculation\n\n")

cat("**Expenditure Components Analyzed:**\n\n")
cat("• **P2 (Intermediate Consumption)**: Government procurement and outsourcing\n")
cat("• **D1 (Compensation of Employees)**: Public sector wages and salaries\n")
cat("• **P5 (Gross Fixed Capital)**: Public investment in infrastructure\n")
cat("• **COFOG**: Functional classification by policy area\n")
```

```{r}
# Create a formatted summary table
metrics_table <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Intermediate Consumption (P2) Average Share",
    "Compensation of Employees (D1) Average Share", 
    "Gross Fixed Capital (P5) Average Share",
    "P2/D1 Ratio (Outsourcing Intensity)",
    "P2 Average Annual Growth",
    "D1 Average Annual Growth", 
    "P5 Average Annual Growth",
    "P2-D1 Growth Correlation"
  ),
  Value = c(
    paste0(round(summary_stats[Metric == "P2_Avg_Share", Value], 1), "%"),
    paste0(round(summary_stats[Metric == "D1_Avg_Share", Value], 1), "%"),
    paste0(round(summary_stats[Metric == "P5_Avg_Share", Value], 1), "%"),
    round(summary_stats[Metric == "P2_D1_Correlation", Value], 3),
    paste0(round(summary_stats[Metric == "P2_Avg_Growth", Value], 2), "%"),
    paste0(round(summary_stats[Metric == "D1_Avg_Growth", Value], 2), "%"),
    paste0(round(summary_stats[Metric == "P5_Avg_Growth", Value], 2), "%"),
    round(summary_stats[Metric == "P2_D1_Correlation", Value], 3)
  ),
  Interpretation = c(
    "Procurement share of total expenditure",
    "Public employment costs share",
    "Public investment share", 
    "Balance between outsourcing and public employment",
    "Annual growth in procurement spending",
    "Annual growth in public employment costs",
    "Annual growth in public investment",
    "Relationship between P2 and D1 growth"
  )
)

kable(metrics_table, caption = "Key Expenditure Metrics (EU-27 Average, 2006-2021)")
```

```{r}
ggplot(growth_year[!is.na(growth)], aes(x = year, y = growth, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3")) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Annual Growth Rate of Expenditure Components (EU-27, 2006–2021)",
    x = "Year", y = "Growth Rate (%)", 
    color = "Component"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
ggplot(composition_year, aes(x = year, y = share, fill = component)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3")) +
  labs(
    title = "Composition of Public Expenditure by Economic Type (EU-27, 2006–2021)",
    x = "Year", y = "Share of Total Expenditure", 
    fill = "Component"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


```{r}
ggplot(composition_year, aes(x = year, y = share, color = component)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3")) +
  labs(
    title = "Expenditure Shares by Economic Type - Line Chart View",
    subtitle = "EU-27 Average (2006-2021)",
    x = "Year", y = "Share of Total Expenditure", 
    color = "Component"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


```{r}
ggplot(cofog_long, aes(x = year, y = share, fill = policy_function)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Composition of Public Expenditure by Policy Function (COFOG, EU-27, 2006–2021)",
    x = "Year", y = "Share of Total Expenditure", 
    fill = "Function"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


```{r}
ggplot(substitution_trends, aes(x = year, y = mean_p2_d1_ratio)) +
  geom_line(color = "#e7298a", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "#e7298a", size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    title = "P2/D1 Ratio - Procurement vs Public Employment Intensity",
    subtitle = "Higher values indicate greater reliance on external procurement\nEU-27 Average (2006-2021)",
    x = "Year", y = "P2/D1 Ratio"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
growth_comparison <- growth_year[!is.na(growth)] %>%
  filter(year >= 2007)  # Remove 2006 as it has NA values

ggplot(growth_comparison, aes(x = year, y = growth, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3")) +
  labs(
    title = "Growth Rate Comparison of Expenditure Components",
    subtitle = "EU-27 Average Annual Growth (2007-2021)\nDiverging trends may indicate substitution effects",
    x = "Year", y = "Growth Rate (%)", 
    color = "Component"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
# Display country variation tables
top_countries <- head(country_variation, 8)
bottom_countries <- tail(country_variation, 8)

cat("**Countries with Highest Outsourcing Intensity (P2/D1 Ratio > 0.7):**\n")
kable(top_countries, caption = "Highest P2/D1 Ratios - 2021")

cat("\n**Countries with Lowest Outsourcing Intensity (P2/D1 Ratio < 0.45):**\n")
kable(bottom_countries, caption = "Lowest P2/D1 Ratios - 2021")
```
